Social security insurance is unusable. Why don't they take down the sign saying it's not covered? That way, I wouldn't waste time chasing after Social Security myself, which is already difficult. To make matters worse, the dentist poked my gums with the instrument, causing bleeding. Instead of apologizing or anything, they just filled out the medical certificate stating "gingivitis" and made me pay extra for antiseptic mouthwash. I've had tartar removed and checked at dozens of clinics, and this is the first time they've ever diagnosed "gingivitis." Of course, they poked my gums until they bled!

When I asked if they could help, they said the Social Security system was down, an unforeseen circumstance, and I had to handle it myself. But they could have told me beforehand! I asked other clinics, and they said the system has been down for days. You could inform customers that Social Security insurance isn't covered so they wouldn't come.

And when I asked about compensation for the bleeding, they said they would ask head office about it, but I haven't received an answer for weeks.

I am extremely dissatisfied and will never use their services again.
